p='/app/public/app.js'
s=open(p).read()

s=s.replace("function markDirty(){clearTimeout(state.saveTimer);", "function markDirty(){if(state.dirtyBase===null)state.dirtyBase=state.revision;clearTimeout(state.saveTimer);")
s=s.replace("sending=[...state.dirty].map(a=>({sheetId:state.sheet.id,address:a,raw:state.cells[a]||''})),base=state.revision;", "sending=[...state.dirty].map(a=>({sheetId:state.sheet.id,address:a,raw:state.cells[a]||''})),base=state.dirtyBase??state.revision;")
s=s.replace("setSaveState(state.dirty.size?'dirty':'saved',state.dirty.size?'Unsaved changes':'Saved');if(state.dirty.size)markDirty()", "if(!state.dirty.size)state.dirtyBase=null;setSaveState(state.dirty.size?'dirty':'saved',state.dirty.size?'Unsaved changes':'Saved');if(state.dirty.size)markDirty()")
s=s.replace("$('historyBtn').onclick=()=>{", "$('cellHistoryBtn').onclick=cellHistory;$('historyBtn').onclick=()=>{")
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
node --check /app/public/app.js && node --check /app/server.js
grep -o "dirtyBase[^;]*" /app/public/app.js | head -5
